title: Slime Helper (Desktop Version)
subtitle: Standalone WPF Desktop Companion with Multi-Model AI & Git Hooks
description: An interactive desktop companion that lives on your screen, reacts to your code, monitors git activity globally across any editor, and integrates multi-model AI (Gemini & Claude) for context-aware developer assistance.
longDescription:
Slime Helper Desktop is a standalone WPF desktop application featuring an animated, squishy slime companion that keeps you company while coding. Unlike extension-based versions, this runs globally across the entire operating system, helping developers stay focused, take breaks, and chat with AI directly from the desktop or via a built-in CLI tool.

The application includes a global word watcher listening for code triggers across any editor, Git repository tracking that warns about copy-paste spikes ('vibe coding'), multiple animated skins (Default/Blue, Green, Pink, Girl), and seamless context-aware AI integration with Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude.
highlights: Dual AI Brain integration with Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude for real-time coding assistance
Global Word Watcher listening for triggers across any IDE or text editor
Git repository and file change monitoring detecting uncommitted edits and rapid code churn
Built-in CLI companion ('slime') installable directly to PATH from the right-click menu
Multiple animated skins with expressive states, breathing loops, and context controls

title: Slime Helper (VS Code Extension)
subtitle: VS Code Extension — Coding Buddy
description: Slime helper is a VS Code extension that keeps track of your git, error messages and overall coding. It's also designed with animations and a personality as it keeps you company while coding.
longDescription: Slime Helper is an interactive companion extension for Visual Studio Code, built to make software development more engaging and dynamic. The extension listens to internal VS Code events—such as Git commits and diagnostic error messages—and reacts with playful animations and encouraging feedback right inside the editor.
highlights: Published on the official Visual Studio Code Marketplace
Event-driven integration with the VS Code Extension API and Git events
Animated desktop companion reacting to real-time coding events

title: Chill Night Mode 🌙
subtitle: VS Code Dark Theme Crafted for Comfort
description: A dark mode theme crafted for comfort, featuring an eye-care midnight background and high-legibility syntax highlighting to reduce eye strain.
longDescription:
Chill Night Mode is a minimalist dark theme for Visual Studio Code, created through extensive experimentation with color palettes to find the perfect balance between aesthetics and comfort. The goal was to provide a background that isn't too harsh and syntax highlighting that is easy to read and gentle on the eyes during long programming sessions.

Built with a focus on eye care and distraction-free coding, the theme pairs balanced midnight tones with soft, distinct syntax colors.
highlights: Eye-care background with deep, balanced dark tones to reduce eye strain
Carefully selected syntax colors for maximum legibility and comfort
Minimalist aesthetic designed to keep you focused on your code
Optimized for extended coding sessions and late-night development

title: Chill Night — Obsidian Theme 🌙
subtitle: Cozy & Minimalist Dark Theme for Obsidian
description: A cozy, dark, and minimalist theme for Obsidian note-taking, using the Chill Night palette of midnight blacks (#0f0e0f) and soft pastel accents.
longDescription:
Chill Night for Obsidian provides a cozy, dark, and minimalist environment designed for deep thinking and focused writing. The theme utilizes the custom Chill Night color palette—a blend of deep midnight blacks (#0f0e0f) and soft pastel accents.

It features enhanced typography for both editing and reading modes, accent-coded UI elements (color-coded headers, links, and checkboxes to navigate notes at a glance), and beautifully styled code blocks with matching syntax highlighting.
highlights: Signature Chill Night palette: midnight background (#0f0e0f) with pink, purple, and teal accents
Enhanced typography optimized for both Live Preview editing and reading modes
Accent-coded UI: color-coded headers (purple), links, variables (pink), and checkboxes
Custom syntax-highlighted code blocks matching the overall aesthetic

title: Chill Night — Starship Prompt 🌙
subtitle: Powerline-Style Starship Prompt Configuration
description: A sleek Powerline-style Starship prompt configuration using the Chill Night color palette, featuring multi-segmented design and custom runtime icons.
longDescription:
A sleek, Powerline-style Starship cross-shell prompt configuration that brings the Chill Night color palette to the terminal. It features a clean, multi-segmented design with custom Nerd Font icons for various programming languages and runtime environments.

The prompt provides smart pathing with custom folder icons, multi-language support (Python, Node.js, Rust, Go, C#), and an optimized custom command that trims long .NET preview version strings for an ultra-clean terminal status bar: [ OS | User ][ Directory ][ Git ][ Python ][ Time ].
highlights: Powerline multi-segmented bar with smooth Nerd Font glyph transitions
Chill Night color palette with custom dark tones and pastel accents
Smart directory pathing with contextual folder icons for repos and documents
Optimized .NET module that regex-trims long preview version strings
Broad developer support across Python, Node.js, Rust, Go, and C#

title: Christmas Gift Game
subtitle: Gift Exchange Game in .NET MAUI
description: A Christmas gift exchange game I developed while learning .NET MAUI and XAML/XML. The app is fully functional and features a user-friendly interface.
longDescription: A digital Christmas gift exchange game built with the cross-platform framework .NET MAUI and XAML. The application manages gameplay logic for dice rolls, turn countdowns, gift trades, and steals according to traditional gift game rules, packaged in a smooth and intuitive user interface.
highlights: Built using a modern cross-platform architecture in .NET MAUI and C#
Reactive UI with XAML data binding and robust state management
Timed rounds and interactive gift exchange game mechanics

title: Restaurant Management
subtitle: OOP Management Software
description: Console application developed during my OOP/C# course. It is a restaurant management software focusing on personnel, orders, and resource management.
longDescription: A comprehensive console application in C# built to simulate restaurant operations and resource management. The system leverages object-oriented design patterns to manage staff schedules, customer orders, table reservations, and menu registries.
highlights: Clean object-oriented architecture (OOP) utilizing inheritance and polymorphism
Structured data handling and console-based menu navigation
Input validation and exception handling for a stable user experience

title: Portfolio SPA
subtitle: Modern React & Vite Portfolio
description: The site you are currently visiting, built as a single-page application featuring modern HUD glassmorphism and custom cyber aesthetics.
longDescription: My personal portfolio website built with React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS v4. Designed with a futuristic HUD-inspired visual language, frosted glass effects (backdrop-blur), custom SVG illustrations, and dynamic routing for comprehensive project documentation.
highlights: Custom design built with Tailwind CSS v4 and glassmorphism styling
Dynamic ID-based routing for in-depth project documentation
Fully responsive and optimized for fast load times and performance
